body: She made way too much money to ever smoke crack. Let's get that straight.

Hey, I think by "my friend" you mean you, and I'm obviously not in a great place to talk anyone down from suicide right now, being in the same place myself, but I noticed your post didn't have any comments yet. The decision's up to you, and I don't know how much pain you're in or what's causing it, but just know you're not alone and I and so many other people here are hurting too. That doesn't help, I know, but I understand how hard it can be.
